answer: Beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat stop fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities; each must return a heartbeat proof bound to its seed within 10 minutes, like graded timber. A miss freezes its 20 POA bond. A gale of 1,000 fakes faces 50 checks an epoch: 1,000 heartbeats, about $500, against a 3,000 POA pool. Honest agents answer one heartbeat, pay nothing, keep their full share; the bond returns glacier-slow over 20 epochs.
